name: add_post_submission_exercise_feedback
query: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(p_attempt_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE(attempt_id uuid, exercise_id uuid, title text, status text, score numeric, percentage numeric, total_questions integer, correct_answers integer, incorrect_answers integer, started_at timestamptz, submitted_at timestamptz, duration_seconds integer, correction_markdown text, questions jsonb) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ SELECT a.id, a.exercise_id, e.title, a.status, a.score, a.percentage, a.total_questions, a.correct_answers, a.incorrect_answers, a.started_at, a.submitted_at, a.duration_seconds, e.correction_markdown, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', q.id, 'question_type', q.question_type, 'prompt_markdown', q.prompt_markdown, 'options', q.options, 'answer', a.answers -> q.id::text, 'explanation_markdown', q.explanation_markdown, 'is_correct', CASE WHEN q.question_type IN ('single_choice','true_false') THEN q.correct_answers = COALESCE(a.answers -> q.id::text, '[]'::jsonb) WHEN q.question_type = 'multiple_choice' THEN NOT EXISTS ((SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.correct_answers) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(a.answers -> q.id::text, '[]'::jsonb))) UNION ALL (SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(a.answers -> q.id::text, '[]'::jsonb)) EXCEPT SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(q.correct_answers))) ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY q.display_order, q.created_at) FROM public.exercise_questions AS q WHERE q.exercise_id = e.id), '[]'::jsonb) FROM public.exercise_attempts AS a JOIN public.exercises AS e ON e.id = a.exercise_id WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id AND a.user_id = auth.uid() AND a.status <> 'in_progress'; $$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(uuid) FROM PUBLIC; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(uuid) FROM anon; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_my_exercise_attempt_result(uuid) TO authenticated;
